in_marathi.name: Lalima
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Beauty and Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lalima is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Lal' meaning 'red' and 'ima' meaning 'mother'. This name is associated with the Goddess of Love, Lakshmi, and is believed to bring beauty, grace, and happiness to the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Lalima is also considered a symbol of maternal love and compassion.
